person_note: The controlling narration is third person, with changing focal characters rather than changing grammatical person. The strongest Goodreads passages sustain external narration through Elfrida and Carrie, while the authorized opening independently does the same. Scholarly whole-book analysis samples third-person narration through all five principal characters, and an explicit full-book review confirms that the character-titled chapters remain third person. q00215 is local first-person character reflection, consistent with the study's treatment of such passages as quoted character commentary, not an autonomous first-person section. No credible evidence of alternating base narration remains.
